title: Share evaluation
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, let $s\in F$, let $q$ be a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$, and let $a\in F$ be nonzero. In the specified sharing scheme, the share of $s$ using randomness $q$ for party $a$ is the value at $a$ of the polynomial $s+Xq(X)$.
